items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The Zustellungsurkunde on page 2 states the formal service (förmliche Zustellung nach § 182 ZPO) took place on 23.11.2026 (Monday); this actual date, not an authority deemed-delivery fiction, is the anchor because the letter was served via Postzustellungsurkunde. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (23.11.) is not counted; the two-week period starts 24.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends two weeks later, on Monday 07.12.2026. That day is a normal business day in Niedersachsen (no public holiday), so no weekend/holiday shift applies. The Einspruch must reach the Bußgeldstelle by this date.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft zu zahlen.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) only if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period ending 07.12.2026 (see the objection item above); legal force is deemed to enter the following day, Tuesday 08.12.2026 (this assumes no objection is lodged). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day is not counted; the two-week payment period runs from 09.12.2026 and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on Tuesday 22.12.2026, which is an ordinary business day in Niedersachsen so no shift is needed. This date is therefore the earliest it could be due, and only applies if the Einspruch deadline passes unused; filing an Einspruch would suspend this payment obligation entirely pending the outcome.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-12-22) assumes no Einspruch is filed; if an Einspruch is lodged by 2026-12-07, the fine is not yet due and the Rechtskraft date (and hence the payment deadline) will depend on how the objection is resolved.

Before paying, verify the printed IBAN (DE17 2805 0100 0002 6655 00, bank code 28050100 – Oldenburgische Landesbank) against another trusted source for this Landkreis, since the IBAN's validity does not prove it belongs to the Bußgeldstelle.

The sender's email domain (landkreis-musterammerland-bu.example) and the Landkreis name appear to be placeholder/example values rather than a real, verifiable authority — confirm the sender's genuine contact details before acting on this letter.
